name: IEC combined photoelectric sensor: normally open emitter-receiver AC/DC driven 2 pin

summary: Combined photoelectric sensor form: Normally Open Emitter-Receiver AC/DC Driven 2 PIN.
description: A combined photoelectric sensor contains an emitter and a receiver within the same documented sensing unit. This entry identifies the normally open emitter-receiver ac/dc driven 2 pin form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

A reflective sensing arrangement can detect a passing object or a change in returned light and send the result to a control input. The normally-open designation starts with a non-conducting output or open contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state. The two-connection interface must be read with the load and supply arrangement. Leakage current and minimum load can matter where a powered device is connected in series with an input.

The publisher identifies an AC/DC supply form. Its permissible voltage range and the connected input still need to match the selected equipment. The combined housing does not establish whether a reflector or the target returns the light. Sensing mode, light-on or dark-on selection and pin functions need the selected product diagram.
